Use case: stylized-concept. Draw eight complete animation key poses for a rhinoceros.
Image 1 is the CHARACTER REFERENCE: same friendly faceted softly shaded three-dimensional low-poly rhinoceros, preserve face, palette, anatomy, proportions, lighting and distinctive details.
Image 2 is a LEG PHASE GUIDE. Ignore its generic head/body drawing, labels, colored lines and white backdrop, but draw this character's FOUR LEGS in the exact corresponding phase of each guide cell. Orange = brighter foreground FRONT leg; blue = darker far/background FRONT leg; purple = brighter foreground HIND; green = darker far HIND. Give the two front legs different positions; their identities MUST swap leading/trailing by half a cycle. This is not a posture suggestion: all eight different leg phases are required.
ONE PNG sprite sheet with actual transparent alpha, 2 equal columns x 4 equal rows of square cells. Chronological row-major order. All characters face LEFT, fixed torso x52% and fixed invisible ground y88% in each cell. Same scale throughout; body fits inside 84% of cell width, no clipping of tail/horns/trunk/feet. Transparent gutters around all cells. No ground/cast shadow/haze/white or brown background, no grid, words or numbers.
At cell0 the darker far FRONT leg extends LEFT and brighter near FRONT leg is planted behind/right of shoulder. At cell2 the brighter near FRONT leg extends LEFT and far-front is behind/right. At cell4 the brighter near-front still supports LEFT and far-front begins to lift; at cell6 the darker far FRONT leg extends LEFT and brighter near FRONT leg is behind/right. Follow exact guide cycle for hind legs too, no repeated same static foreleg.
Real anatomical weight-bearing WALK with three feet planted and one swinging; keep all four limbs attached and visible, no floating or rubber stretches. Leg flexion at real joints, not body morphing. Far legs slightly darker to track their identity. Same face/head/body silhouette through poses, only small weight shift. Preserve two ivory horns and large friendly eye, heavy deliberate planted steps, slight ear twitch, no galloping.
alpha: RGBA, actual alpha 0 background; hidden RGB brown in elephant/buffalo should not be rendered opaque

QA.forelegIdentities: Opposite contact roles are visible; verify intermediate timing in browser before calling full-cycle gait anatomically approved.
